propositions: FixedBench shows 35-65% over-action (plans add mechanisms without establishing need) but no plan-review criterion exists to flag plans lacking reproduction or motivation
Bug tickets currently short-circuit to bare exempt-PASS with zero LLM calls and zero findings, bypassing substantive review entirely
A new advisory criterion 'necessity' must flag plans that do not demonstrate change is needed, accepting well-motivated outcomes and docs-test-only changes
Bugs must flow through a lightweight advisory review tier (DET floor + necessity probe only) instead of exempt-PASS, ensuring they receive substantive advisory coverage without blocking
The necessity criterion must be registered in CANONICAL_LLM and criteria_routing.json with advisory posture and must apply to bugs (no suppress_types entry for bug)
Both advisory criteria must auto-flow into the standing per-criterion effectiveness recorder for dogfood monitoring before any advisory-to-blocking promotion gate decision
